technical-summary: The release-please workflow reconciles the open platform release PR with main after an engine release: a new step merges main into the PR branch resolving only the shared manifest (platform version from the PR, other packages from main; refuses other conflicts, missing keys, downgrades), pushes a plain merge commit only while the PR head is unchanged, and never merges. The manifest rule moved to manifest_reconcile and pin-release uses it.
user-summary-candidate: The platform release PR no longer needs a hand-merged manifest after an engine release.
